relevant_open_questions.question: Số ca sEMG/tháng và phân bố theo bệnh lý/protocol là bao nhiêu?
relevant_open_questions.why_it_matters: Cần sizing workload, baseline và sampling plan.
relevant_open_questions.evidence_needed: Case-volume log/de-identified operational count from MotionLab
relevant_open_questions.blocking_scope: Time-motion baseline and pilot cohort sizing
relevant_open_questions.fallback: Use qualitative workflow mapping; do not invent volume.

relevant_open_questions.question: Manual processing time theo từng công đoạn và toàn ca là bao nhiêu?
relevant_open_questions.why_it_matters: North Star và KPI giảm toil cần baseline thực đo.
relevant_open_questions.blocking_scope: KPI baseline and pilot success definition
relevant_open_questions.fallback: Keep ≥60 min/case and ≥50% only as documented estimate/research target, not baseline.

relevant_open_questions.question: Tỷ lệ đo lại là bao nhiêu và nguyên nhân đo lại được phân loại thế nào?
relevant_open_questions.why_it_matters: QC benefit cannot be measured without remeasurement baseline/reasons.
relevant_open_questions.evidence_needed: Historical/observed remeasurement log with reason taxonomy
relevant_open_questions.fallback: Record occurrence qualitatively; do not invent rate.

relevant_open_questions.question: Filter/normalization/window/protocol hiện bác sĩ dùng là gì và nguồn tham chiếu nào?
relevant_open_questions.why_it_matters: Preprocessing profile must preserve physiology and match workflow.
relevant_open_questions.evidence_needed: Current MR4/myoRESEARCH settings, SOP/protocol and clinician confirmation
relevant_open_questions.fallback: No universal pipeline/threshold; configuration remains TBD.

relevant_open_questions.question: Output sEMG cuối hiện hỗ trợ quyết định lâm sàng cụ thể nào?
relevant_open_questions.why_it_matters: Metric selection and interpretation boundary depend on actual decision context.
relevant_open_questions.evidence_needed: Clinician interview + current report/examples with de-identification
relevant_open_questions.fallback: Limit Day01 to technical evidence support; no new clinical claim.

relevant_open_questions.question: PHI/identifier, consent và de-identification workflow site là gì?
relevant_open_questions.why_it_matters: Real patient data governance is a prerequisite.
relevant_open_questions.evidence_needed: Approved Vinmec governance path, de-identification SOP, access/retention decision
relevant_open_questions.fallback: Do not ingest/commit raw patient data into the repo/Day01 pack.
